title: Expectation under the Shapley cube distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, identify vectors in $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$ with subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ by their supports, and let $f:(\mathbb{F}_2)^n\to\mathbb{R}$. Choose an integer $k$ uniformly from $0$ through $n$, then choose uniformly a subset of size $k$ and take its indicator vector. The expectation of $f$ under this vector distribution equals the expectation of the function on subsets that sends $S$ to the value of $f$ at the indicator vector of $S$, under the corresponding subset distribution.
